newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet adds $19 one-way companion fares.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet adds $19 one-way companion fares.

text.p: ValuJet Inc said Wednesday it will offer a $19 one-way companion fare as part of its new fare structure.
ValuJet also reduced its 21-day advance purchase fares by $10, and added 14-day and two-day advance purchase options.
ValuJet returned to the skies September 30 after being grounded in June, following the crash of ValuJet Flight 592 crash in the Florida Everglades.
The new "ValuFares" begin November 1, following a month of introductory fares the carrier offered when it first resumed operations.
The carrier now operates 102 daily departures to 17 cities with a fleet of 15 aircraft.
